lessons.trigger_condition: User requested reconstruction of missing image-card bridges and tablet-only automated collection.
lessons.prevention_rule: Exact game/code/edition/kind identity, private tablet storage, bounded collection with cooldown, lossless-only smaller images; source changes use reviewed PR and current-head checks.
validation_required: Private image quotas, identity conflicts and safe source-adoption rollback
Current-head runtime manifest, CSP and navigation regressions
Immutable V645 and V646 source proofs
Separate physical tablet running-build, collection and reboot readback
lessons.safety_boundary: No image upload, invented metadata, unverified labels, calibration changes, cloud runtime or verification bypass.
